name: Facebook Community Sales OS - Social AIO Runtime
notes: V1.9.6.3 Canonical Group Dispatch HF1: checkbox-selected duplicate registry rows are resolved to one canonical Group row before Worker assignment, preserving manual intent without issuing duplicate FBAIO requests.
Duplicate rows selected manually are disabled, unchecked, and retained only for audit with DUPLICATE_SELECTION_REDIRECT evidence.
Manual retry excludes duplicate rows; stale Worker jobs targeting a duplicate fail closed as SKIP_DUPLICATE before any Social AIO/FBAIO call.
Numeric Group ID fallback can inherit verified evidence from sibling rows with the same canonical Group identity, covering old import-only duplicate rows.
Worker Keeper V1.2.2 edge-triggers E_FB_GROUP_ID_RESOLVE so a stale FBAIO error message cannot generate a duplicate WARN every minute.
V1.9.6.2 Auto Monitor Readiness HF1: CI now asserts that checkbox-selected backend reads no Due Queue state and that stale-due revalidation exists only under jobMode=due.

Partial Group scans that stop with a cursor because the per-job scan time budget is exhausted are classified TIME_BUDGET and enter bounded Auto Monitor retry/backoff instead of being stranded as UNKNOWN.
Due Queue now excludes duplicate active registry rows using the existing duplicate identity detector before scheduling.

V1.9.6.1: digit-leading vanity Group slugs with a previously verified numeric ID are routed directly to that numeric ID before the first FBAIO call, avoiding the observed fb.com/3 parser failure entirely.

V1.9.6 FBAIO Group ID Fallback: if FBAIO mis-parses a vanity Group slug (notably digit-leading slugs such as 3diot...) as a user/page or truncated ID, runtime detects the identity-resolution error and retries using a previously verified numeric Group ID from the same registry row.

The fallback numeric ID is derived only from verified local evidence: Group ID cell when numeric, canonical-identity note, or the last successful api_posts_<numeric-id> filename. No guessed ID is generated.
Primary identity failures, numeric fallback PASS/FAIL, and worker/direct scan failures are persisted automatically to NHAT KY API with runtime version and raw relay evidence where available.
GROUP_ID_RESOLVE is classified separately from connection/transient failures so Auto Monitor does not waste retries or mark a healthy Worker offline for a FBAIO parser defect.
Worker Keeper V1.2.1 detects Wrong ID / FB account not found and only-supports-group UI errors as WARN while keeping the connected Worker healthy.
V1.9.5 Scan Scope Security HF1: manual CHECKBOX selection and scheduler DUE queue now have explicit, non-interchangeable scope contracts.
Control Center fails closed if Runtime.js and ImportDialog.html are from different UI contract generations.
Bootstrap V2.3 atomically refreshes Runtime + HTML whenever the Control Center opens, preventing stale cached UI from invoking a changed command contract.
Selected scan uses PREPARE_SELECTED_WORKER_BATCH and requires CHECKBOX_SELECTION; Due Queue requires SCHEDULER_DUE; worker execution validates jobMode.
Security regression CI asserts command/scope separation and prevents reintroduction of selected-vs-due routing regressions.
V1.9.1-HF4 Run Scope: replaces sticky global STOP_ALL behavior in the V1.9 worker engine with per-run cancellation tokens keyed by runId.
Every selected/retry/due worker plan gets a unique runId; every job carries that runId; STOP and Pause Auto only cancel that run, never a future run.
The production scanner no longer reads the legacy STOP_ALL property. Legacy STOP_ALL is cleanup-only and cannot poison new scans.
Run cancellation is TTL-bound and cleaned at batch finalization. Unstarted jobs return SKIP_STOPPED_RUN without being mislabeled as API failures.
Mid-run cancellation records stopScope=RUN and leaves the Group reusable for later cycles instead of creating a sticky stopped state.
Selected/retry Group keys now derive from the Facebook URL first, protecting long numeric IDs from Google Sheets scientific notation.
HF2 raw-wrapper parsing and empty-page retry, HF1 transient retry/lease/fault-isolation, identity, worker health, exact-batch AI, Signal Feed and Lead Hard Gate remain protected.
V1.9.1-HF3 Stop State: clears stale global STOP_ALL whenever a new selected/retry/due scan plan starts, so a previous Stop action cannot poison later scans.
If STOP is observed before any post is fetched, the scanner now returns a structured STOPPED result instead of misreporting 'API returned no posts'.
Direct active-row and legacy retry runs also clear stale STOP_ALL before starting.
HF2 raw-wrapper parsing and HTTP-200 empty-page retry remain active; HF1 retry, per-Group lease, stale Due Queue guard and AUTO fault isolation remain active.
V1.9.1-HF2 Raw Pagination: production Group scanner now parses the raw relay wrapper directly, matching the API diagnostic path instead of parsing the already-unwrapped response.

HTTP 200 empty/partial pages are retried up to 3 times on the same cursor before the scanner declares the page exhausted; first-page false empties are classified as transient instead of generic no-post errors.
Long numeric Facebook Group IDs are derived from the URL first so scientific-notation display in Google Sheets cannot corrupt lease/diagnostic/group-key semantics.
HF1 transient HTTP retry, per-Group lease, stale Due Queue guard and AUTO fault isolation remain active.
Pagination/cursor, Group identity normalization, Worker health, exact-batch AI, Signal Feed and Lead Qualification Hard Gate semantics remain protected.
V1.9.1-HF1 Monitor Safety: fixes false-positive pagination diagnostics now that the production scanner already reads cursor from the raw wrapper.

Scanner retries transient relay errors (429/502/503/504, timeout/network class) up to 3 attempts with backoff; if a later page still fails, already collected posts are preserved and the Group is marked THIEU for retry.
Adds a cross-execution per-Group lease in Document Properties so AUTO, manual scan, retry, or a second Control Center cannot scan and overwrite the same Group concurrently.
Due Queue jobs carry their mode and re-check CẦN QUÉT server-side immediately before execution, preventing stale plans from rescanning a Group that another execution already completed.
AUTO MONITOR now quarantines isolated LỖI/THIẾU Groups and continues. Global pause is reserved for Worker connection failure or broad failure rate patterns.
Pagination/cursor, Group identity normalization, Worker health, exact-batch AI, Signal Feed and Lead Qualification Hard Gate semantics are preserved.
V1.9.1 Signal Feed: adds a dedicated TIN HIEU operational view for the latest 7 days while preserving CO HOI as the source-of-truth.
Signal Feed groups data by Day -> Group summary -> candidate rows and uses native Google Sheets row outlines; day groups stay expanded while PASS/WATCH/REVIEW children are collapsed by default.
FAIL rows remain in backend but are excluded from the Signal Feed to reduce operator noise.
Group/day summary shows total sources, candidate count, PASS, WATCH, top gate and max score; child rows keep person, source type, pain, gate, score, evidence, next action and source URL.
Control Center adds direct navigation to TIN HIEU and Lead Inbox.
Signal Feed is rebuilt after AI/full refresh so it remains a presentation layer only and cannot alter AI, dedupe, identity, pagination or Lead Gate semantics.
V1.9.0 200G Pilot: adds Monitoring Overview and a priority-aware Due Queue for up to 200 active Facebook Groups using the existing QUET NHOM cadence/next-scan fields.
Control Center adds an operational dashboard with active/due/running/exception/new-post/AI-backlog/PASS/Worker KPIs and AUTO MONITOR orchestration while the Control Center remains open.
Due Queue excludes confirmed ERROR/INCOMPLETE/STOPPED Groups from unattended loops, prioritizes Uu tien > Giu > Thu nghiem > Giam uu tien, and processes up to 30 Groups per cycle.
Worker imports now use a Document Lock, single-source fast dedupe reads, append-only writes during parallel jobs, and one CƠ HỘI sort at batch finalization to reduce sheet row shifting.
Post-scan finalization uses a lighter refresh path; the full lead/timeline refresh is deferred to AI completion.
AUTO AI processes exact new Source IDs in sequential chunks of 150 so a large 200-Group cycle cannot silently leave newly scanned sources unanalyzed because of the previous maxRows=200 ceiling.
Group-state polling is reduced from 2s to 5s and Monitoring Overview polls every 15s to lower Apps Script chatter.
Pagination/cursor behavior, Group identity normalization, Worker health semantics, manual JSON fallback and Lead Qualification Hard Gate are preserved.
Worker Health hotfix: replace ambiguous testOk-only ONLINE/OFFLINE semantics with evidence-based UNCONFIGURED, UNKNOWN, ONLINE, STALE and OFFLINE states.
ONLINE evidence can come from TEST WORKER or a successful Group scan; successful batch and direct-row scans now update lastSuccessAt/lastJobAt automatically.
OFFLINE is reserved for newer explicit connection/test failure evidence; UNKNOWN means configured but unverified, and STALE means the last success is older than the 15-minute health TTL.
Dispatcher excludes confirmed OFFLINE workers, still allows UNKNOWN/STALE workers so a normal scan can re-establish ONLINE, and preserves Profile pinning behavior.
Changing CLIENT_ID resets health evidence so a new Worker identity cannot inherit status from the previous credential.
Pagination, Group identity normalization, exact-batch AUTO AI attribution, Lead Qualification Hard Gate and manual JSON fallback are unchanged.
P0 identity normalization fix.2: every API-driven Group scan with sourceRow now normalizes the exact QUET NHOM source row even when Facebook keeps the same numeric Group key.
resolvedScanGroupKey uses canonical fileGroupKey when available and falls back to the original sourceGroupKey; numeric-to-slug and numeric-to-numeric scans share the same source-row path.
The hotfix preserves target count, pagination/cursor logic, exact-batch AUTO AI attribution, Lead Qualification Hard Gate, and manual JSON fallback behavior.

P0 identity/upsert hotfix: API Group scans now bind canonical vanity slug identity back to the exact QUET NHOM source row instead of appending a duplicate row when the input URL uses a numeric Group ID.
Scan source metadata (source row, source URL, source key) is carried into import for API-driven scans; manual JSON import keeps the legacy fallback registration behavior.
Source-row binding is fail-closed and preserves operator-selected target count, existing non-placeholder group name, formulas, pagination behavior, and Lead Qualification Hard Gate.
Lead Qualification Hard Gate separates need detection from actual sales qualification.
PASS requires Buyer Role=Co, Product Fit=Co and deterministic score >=65; FAIL/WATCH never enter KH PASS counters.
Score components: Need 25 + Product Fit 25 + Action 20 + Urgency 15 + Reachability 10 + Freshness 5.
Per-Group AI Context / Offer in QUET NHOM is the primary Product Fit context; global Business Context is fallback. With no effective context, Product Fit is forced to Chua ro.
AUTO AI is batch-bound: it analyzes only exact Source IDs newly imported by the current Group scan, preventing old waiting rows from leaking into the run.
MANUAL AI can analyze the exact last scan, checked Groups, selected CO HOI rows, all waiting sources, or legacy rows requiring Hard Gate requalification.
Manual JSON import is fallback ingestion and does not auto-run AI.
KHACH HANG TIEM NANG preserves old rows as LEGACY until all known sources for that person are requalified; PASS metrics exclude LEGACY.
Operator bootstrap menu is simplified to Settings, Scan Group, AI Analysis, Refresh Data (when needed), with diagnostics/import/dedupe/version moved under tools/system.
